profile.headline: LBBP, CSM, CSPO - U.S. Army Veteran
profile.jobTitle: Senior Software Engineer – Behavioral Health State Reporting Team Lead
profile.summary:
-	Certified Lean Six Sigma Black Belt 
-	Certified Scrum Product Owner
-	Certified Scrum Master
-	U.S Army Veteran with Leadership, Strong Ethics, Organizational and Teamwork skills.
-	Strong Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills.
-	Project Leadership and Management experience.
-	Experience in working with customers to define requirements and design needs.
-	Many years of experience in the development of software applications for use in the Behavioral 
        Health, Occupational Health, Justice, Education and Ecommerce industries. 
-	Experience and proficiency using development technologies such as SQL Server, Oracle, Sybase 
         ASE, PowerBuilder, XML, JavaScript and C#.
-	Proficiency following strict SDLC guidelines, Workflow Management, Defect/Issue Tracking, 
        Problem Management and Change Tracking across the application life cycle.
-	Able to track and manage Product Backlog, Burn-down charts, Agile velocity charts and task
            break-down charts.
-	Capable to Educate and reinforce scrum methodology to Team members and Stakeholders.
-	Capable to facilitate sprint planning, daily scrums, retrospectives and stakeholder meetings.
-	Capable of creating accurate and efficient Project Charters, Pareto Analysis Diagrams, Stakeholder 
         Analysis, Value Stream Analysis Maps, Fishbone Diagrams, Flowcharts, FMEA charts, 5S method 
          planning, Voice of Customer worksheets and ROI charts.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer – Behavioral Health State Reporting Team Lead
positions.description:
-     Responsible to manage all aspects of State Reporting Department, that includes Team 
       management, multiple simultaneous projects, customer relationships, software  
       implementation and training to internal Staff and Clients.
--	Use of SQL Server and XML technologies to develop a large number of Stored Procedures, Scalar  
        Functions and Triggers Database objects to manage the backend aspect of solutions.
-	Use of PowerBuilder, JavaScript and XML to develop the graphical user interface of solutions.
-	Ongoingly manage the lifecycle of multiple Behavioral Health State Reporting applications to  
        remain current with yearly published State or County government requirement changes.
-	Responsible to mentor, train and guide new team members.
-	Maintain relationship with clients to identify future potential projects.
-	Responsible to provide documentation, training, knowledge transfer and
        technical support to Core Application Implementation team, QA team, Documentation team, 
        Technical Support team and Clients.
-	Proficiency following strict SDLC guidelines, Workflow Management, Defect/Issue Tracking, 
       Problem Management and Change Tracking across the application life cycle.
-	Able to track and manage Product Backlog, Burn-down charts, Agile velocity charts and task 
        break-down charts.
-	Capable to Educate and reinforce scrum methodology to Team members and Stakeholders.
-	Capable to facilitate sprint planning, daily scrums, retrospectives and stakeholder meetings.
-	Capable of creating accurate and efficient Project Charters, Pareto Analysis Diagrams, 
        Stakeholder    Analysis, Value Stream Analysis Maps, Fishbone Diagrams, Flowcharts, FMEA charts,
        5S method planning, Voice of Customer worksheets and ROI charts.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst III
positions.description:
-  Designed and developed new functionality for large Medical Legacy PowerBuilder 
                      Application using PowerBuilder, Sybase ASE DBMS and XML technologies.
                  - Performed analysis, troubleshooting and maintenance of pre-existing functionality in Legacy 
                     Medical application using PowerBuilder, Sybase ASE DBMS and XML technologies.
                  -  Designed and developed various PowerBuilder utilities and applications to 
                     complement the existing legacy Medical System.  An example of such applications include a 
                     Cash Management System module and a Revenue Transaction Management system
                     that exchanges data with Oracle Financials through web services. 
                  -  Created and modified high volume of Stored Procedures, Triggers, Tables and complex
                     SQL statements to manipulate production data.
                  -  Followed strict SDLC standards while adhering to internal waterfall framework.
                  -  Attended Java and XML application development training approved and paid by Concentra.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Client Server application development of Court Management Software using Powerbuilder, Oracle, Oracle PL-SQL, Pegasus Imaging Toolkit, Visual Basic and XML.
